Reference (Kindred destroyed in 1996, no actor) · Seattle Anarch · killed @UUID[JournalEntry.VYpDoFtqKkL7FlqL]{Emily Smith} and was destroyed by @UUID[JournalEntry.3zcQLj7aEAxHT0Yr]{David}.

This page gathers what docs 00–16 say about Dorsey. The source doc for each fact is in parentheses. The docs give him no clan, sire, or stats.

• ID registry: “REF-03 · Ray Dorsey, the Anarch who killed Emily in 1996 (destroyed by David)” (doc 07).
  • He used teenagers from Rainier Valley as his herd (doc 05, story: “Emily's Night (1996)”).
  • In the fall of 1996 he asked @UUID[JournalEntry.WHkwE8CYfaKW5WyO]{Rosa Iturbe} in Everett to put him up for a week: “he said the Sheriff was after him” (doc 07, Rosa's profile). Rosa gave him a bed at the shipyard (doc 11, @UUID[JournalEntry.FttkHsYSSaCpIugu.JournalEntryPage.aJxUAHXcYpRWrhmG]{A2-E03 · Salt's}).
  • A week later he killed Emily Smith, a social worker, in a half-abandoned apartment in Rainier Valley (doc 05; doc 07; doc 11). The obituary dates the death to October 21, 1996 (doc 15, @UUID[JournalEntry.woF61Oy8f19xxrkA]{Emily Smith's Obituary}; a provisional detail according to doc 16).
  • David arrived minutes too late and destroyed him with a single shot (doc 05; doc 07: “the Hound destroyed him with a single shot”).

• The backup who arrived afterward and cleaned up the scene while David was still on the ground was @UUID[JournalEntry.B4nqUk8dojvCw97H]{Hal Brekke}, a Gangrel two years into his unlife (doc 05; doc 02: “he was the one who cleaned up the scene while David was still on his knees”).
  • To the city, it was a score being settled between gangs. To Montgomery, it was the reason he started keeping an eye on his Hound (doc 05). The obituary says the police are investigating it “as a gang-related confrontation” and that “one of the juveniles was unharmed” (doc 15, AYU-04).
  • That juvenile was @UUID[Actor.rOqsigq4dAfIYQMh]{Marcos Delgado}, fifteen years old, the only kid who survived. Before he passed out, he saw a man with a scar on his face shoot Dorsey and kneel beside the social worker (doc 09, @UUID[JournalEntry.AnZpyM4onyACPwiC.JournalEntryPage.pCLncsxglYsxJtbu]{GAN-01 · The Boy Who Survived}).

• Rosa. She didn't know what Dorsey was going to do. She never forgave herself. Since then she has one rule in Everett: nobody who uses minors as a herd (doc 07). Her agenda in Salt's is “to settle the debt of 1996” (doc 08, @UUID[JournalEntry.azX1hjbc0PUp2AA2.JournalEntryPage.SSDCSJFv8Esl6Ki5]{COT-03 · Salt's}).
  • Rumor 11: “Rosa Iturbe sheltered the Anarch who killed the Hound's daughter.” (True. It was in 1996, a week before Emily's death. Rosa didn't know what he was going to do. She never forgave herself) (doc 05).
  • The confession (@UUID[JournalEntry.FttkHsYSSaCpIugu.JournalEntryPage.aJxUAHXcYpRWrhmG]{A2-E03 · Salt's}, doc 11): “There's something I have to tell you. Thirty years ago. A guy named Ray Dorsey asked me to put him up for a week. Said the Sheriff was after him. I gave him a bed at the shipyard. A week later he killed a social worker in Rainier Valley. You know which one.” Doc 01 summed it up like this: “Rosa knew the Anarch who killed Emily.”
